newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Performance Food rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Performance Food rated buy.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Monday it recommended aggressive purchase of Performance Food Group Co in the wake of its extension of its distribution contract with Cracker Barrel Old Country Store Inc.

-- Performance Food Group has had a relationship with Cracker Barrel for more than 20 years, Rodman said, and signing the new agreement "lifts the cloud that has hung over Performance Food Group since last summer."
-- Rodman said it also trimmed its 1997 earnings estimate to $1.12 from $1.18 and its 1998 estimate to $1.36 from $1.43 because of changes in Cracker Barrel's margins.
-- Performace Food Group is a food distribution company.
-- Its shares closed up 1-1/8 Monday at 16.
